SCHEDULE 5 Regulation 3

CONTROLLED DRUGS EXCEPTED FROM THE PROHIBITION ON
IMPORTATION, EXPORTATION AND POSSESSION AND SUBJECT TO THE
REQUIREMENTS OF REGULATIONS 24 AND 26
1.—(1) Any preparation of one or more of the substances to which this paragraph applies, not being
a preparation designed for administration by injection, when compounded with one or more other active
or inert ingredients and containing a total of not more than 100 milligrams of the substance or substances
(calculated as base) per dosage unit or with a total concentration of not more than 2.5% (calculated as
base) in undivided preparations.
